name: Konishi Co., Ltd.
summary: Konishi Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells synthetic adhesives in Japan. It operates through three segments: Bonds, Chemical Products, and Construction Business. The company offers general household adhesives, repair material, and tape for consumer sector; interior construction adhesive, general residential sealant, and construction tape for housing-related fields; industrial adhesives, industrial tape, and industrial release agent, as well as various resin products for industrial materials; building construction repair sealant; and adhesives and repair materials for civil engineering construction. It also trades in chemical products for automotive, electronics and electrical, chemicals, paint…
